goal: Display and input: the kernel can draw and the phone can be touched.

criteria.requirement: Kernel console text is visible on the handset panel, recorded as a photograph with a SHA-256, not only as a description.
criteria.note: Depends on P1.1: the same transport that proves XNU entered is what makes console text possible.

criteria.requirement: NativeMdss scans out a test pattern after taking over from the firmware's GOP, with the transition logged (mode, stride, pixel format, and the point the firmware framebuffer stopped being written).
criteria.note: NativeMdss is at rung 1 (register probe) and publishes no framebuffer.

criteria.requirement: Touch and volume-key events reach an IOHIDEventService and produce an end-to-end log line per event.
criteria.note: Volume keys and GOP input are proven at the EFI menu, not inside XNU.

criteria.requirement: The Apple logo and the lock screen are not P3 criteria: this boot chain has no iBoot to draw the logo, and the lock screen is SpringBoard's.
criteria.note: Moved to P4.3/P4.1 so P3 is not blocked by a picture nothing in this chain produces.
